segments.name: Restaurant Operations
segments.description: Franchises and operates Steak n Shake and Western Sizzlin restaurants, serving burgers, fries and milkshakes to customers and franchise partners.
segments.evidence: Founded in 1934 in Normal, Illinois, on Route 66, Steak n Shake is a classic American brand serving Steakburgers, beef tallow fries, and milkshakes.

segments.name: Insurance Operations
products: physical damage and nontrucking liability insurance
segments.description: Underwrites commercial truck, garage liability, commercial property and homeowners insurance through First Guard, Southern Pioneer and Biglari Reinsurance for policyholders.
segments.evidence: Our insurance operations include First Guard, Southern Pioneer, and Biglari Reinsurance.

segments.name: Oil and Gas Operations
segments.description: Produces oil and natural gas from properties offshore in Louisiana state waters and wells in the Permian Basin.
segments.evidence: Our oil and gas operations include Southern Oil and Abraxas Petroleum.

segments.name: Brand Licensing
segments.description: Licenses the Maxim brand and related publishing rights to partners who market products under its registered brand names.
segments.evidence: Maxim's business lies principally in brand licensing.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for restaurant meals, franchise partner fees and royalties, insurance premiums, oil and gas sales, and brand licensing.
revenueModel.evidence: For company-operated units, sales to the end customer are recorded as revenue generated by the Company, but for franchise partner units, only our share of the restaurant's profits, along with certain fees, are recorded as revenue.
